description.value: Sushi Umi is a Japanese restaurant on Granville Street in Vancouver's South Granville neighbourhood, serving sushi and Japanese cuisine in an indoor-only dining room. The website identifies it explicitly as the 'Granville Location,' suggesting at least one other branch exists. Online ordering is available directly through the restaurant's website.
